decisions.question: UX-401 (escalated): where should the one-time D2a reminder question appear? Two attempts failed: a bottom-bar card (P32) squeezed the agenda at 320x568 with 2x text, and an in-list card at the end of Calendar/Tareas (P48) sits below the fold on a normal 390x844 phone at 1x text, with its buttons under the bottom bar.
decisions.recommendation: Ask once in a modal bottom sheet shown right after the first dated task is saved and visible. Delete the in-list ReminderAskCard. Replace the literal reminder_ask_card_test.dart:139-180 test with the tester's looser one (task hit-testable at launch; both answers hit-testable). This adds no new screen or setting; it changes only how the question decided in D2a is presented. It is a modal interruption, though, so the owner should approve it.

escalated.tried: Round 1 (P32): card in the bottom bar; at 320x568 with 2x text it left the agenda 16 px. Round 2 (P48): card as the last item of Calendar, the Tareas list footer and the empty state, with no height cap; at 390x844 with 1x text it spans y 663-759 under the bottom bar at y 698, and at 1.3-2x text it is fully below the fold. Tests failing: reminder_ask_card_test.dart ~150 and ~347.
